name: Cozy Villa
description: Escape to our stunning villa in Tabanan, Bali, the perfect destination for a romantic getaway, family vacation, or solo retreat. With spacious bedrooms, modern bathrooms, and a private pool surrounded by lush tropical gardens, our villa offers the perfect balance of comfort and tranquility. Located just minutes from local attractions, beautiful beaches, and sacred temples, our villa provides the ideal base to explore Bali’s rich culture while enjoying privacy and serenity.

name: Pool View Family Villa
description: Cozy wooden villa with modern amenities in Kaba-kaba, ideal for a family of three. The room features a double bed, a single bed, a private bathroom, a working desk, smart TV, and a complimentary breakfast for 3 guests. Enjoy access to a shared garden, communal space, main pool, and private parking. The room offers a stunning jungle view. Surrounded by nature, you may also encounter friendly geckos, bees, or butterflies. Mosquitoes can appear in the evenings.

name: Pool Side Villa
description: This cozy room features a comfortable double bed, a working desk for business travelers, and a cozy sofa with a smart TV for entertainment. Enjoy a refreshing hot water shower. Stay connected with free high-speed Wi-Fi and stay cool with air-conditioning. With direct access to the inviting outdoor pool, you’ll enjoy stunning poolside views right from your room.

name: Private Pool Jungle View Villa
description: Enjoy a peaceful stay in our comfortable room, complete with a delicious breakfast to start your day right. Whether you're here for business or leisure, you'll appreciate the cozy ambiance and inviting space.

name: DAISY-DEAL PACKAGE
description: Unlock an exclusive getaway by booking a minimum of three nights directly with us at least seven days in advance. Valid for all villa types, this offer ensures a hassle-free experience with complimentary return airport transfers, welcome drinks upon arrival, unlimited WiFi, and daily breakfast at the Communal Room. To make your stay even more memorable, enjoy a one-time complimentary 30-minute foot massage for two persons and special family perks where kids stay and eat for free.
